name: comp-398
title: Avatar Notification Count
description: A circular profile photo with a small white badge counting unread messages on its upper right, centred above a name and a one-line message total.
use: Showing who a message came from together with how much is waiting from them.
avoid: A live count: the number and photo are fixed inside the file, so they need wiring to real data.
a11y: The portrait carries alt text, but the number is bare text with nothing explaining it to screen readers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A circular portrait roughly 56px wide sits centred on a near-black stage, with a white pill bubble holding a dark 6 overlapping its top-right edge. Below it a bold white name and a dimmer grey message line are stacked and centred.
behaves: Static: the photo, badge and caption never move or respond. Only the recording cursor drifts across the empty space around them.
customise: The count, portrait URL and fallback initials are written inside the file, so adopting it means editing them. The bubble's offset and minimum width live in its class list.
weight: light: A single image and a text badge; no script, loop or animation.
